rows.reason: A sacrifice outlet turns your own unit's When Defeated (or a defeat-watcher) into a triggered payoff on demand.
A unit that defeats itself feeds cards that trigger when a friendly unit is defeated.
Cards that repeat or reward When Defeated abilities need units that carry one.
Damaging your own unit switches on Grit, 'while damaged' and damage-taken triggers.
Token units are cheap bodies to sacrifice, count, or trigger enter-play payoffs.
Experience, Shield tokens and upgrades all count as upgrades for 'upgraded' payoffs.
Readying a unit re-uses its Action [Exhaust] or lets an On Attack unit swing again.
An extra attack fires On Attack and attack-end triggers an extra time.
Returning your own unit to hand lets you replay its When Played ability.
Putting cards in your own discard pile feeds play-from-discard and recursion.
Discard outlets trigger 'when you discard' payoffs.
Card draw fills the hand that hand-size and draw-trigger cards count.
Extra resources reach 'control N or more resources' thresholds sooner.
Exhausting your own unit switches on 'while exhausted' and exhausted-unit payoffs.
Credit producers fund Credit spenders.
Cards that grant the Force fuel 'use the Force' costs and 'while the Force is with you'.
Taking the initiative switches on initiative-gated abilities.
Healing triggers 'when damage is healed' payoffs.
Extra unit plays trigger 'when you play a unit' payoffs.
Removal triggers 'when an enemy unit is defeated' payoffs.
Putting a unit into play from hand, discard, resources or the deck still counts as playing it, which triggers 'when you play a unit' payoffs.
A Pilot that attaches as an upgrade, or a card that plays an extra Pilot, triggers 'when a Pilot attaches to this unit' payoffs.
Returning a Pilot upgrade to hand lets you attach it again, so the 'when a Pilot attaches' trigger fires a second time.
Cards that use a When Played ability again need units that carry one. Example: Death Trooper feeds Qui-Gon Jinn's Aethersprite.
Exhausting an enemy unit switches on cards that reward or punish an exhausted enemy unit. Example: Cat and Mouse feeds Assassin Probe.
A Weakness token on an enemy unit feeds cards that act on enemy units carrying one. Example: Maz Kanata feeds Rish Loo.
Defeating your own upgrade triggers cards that watch for a friendly upgrade being defeated. Example: Reforge feeds Zeb Orrelios.
Damaging the enemy base switches on cards that need an enemy base damaged this phase. Example: Shoot Down feeds Tempest Assault.
A granted Sentinel makes the unit a target for cards that act on units with Sentinel. Example: Academy Graduate feeds Kylo Ren's Command Shuttle.
A granted Hidden makes the unit a target for cards that act on units with Hidden. Example: Third Sister feeds Dooku.
A granted Shielded makes the unit a target for cards that act on units with Shielded. Example: Rio Durant feeds The Armorer.
A card that references a trait wants units with that trait (tribal; ranks as obvious).
